1. When the scenario starts, the robot must announce the delivery via speech within 10 seconds in a quiet office environment.  
2. After the robot announces the delivery, the user must acknowledge the delivery (e.g., via speech or a head nod) within 8 seconds in a quiet office environment.  
3. After the user acknowledges the delivery, the robot must provide a final confirmation of delivery via speech within 1 second in a quiet office environment.
